items.exampleEn: The teacher gave us a digest of the main points from last week.
items.exampleZh: 老師給了我們一份上週重點的摘要。

items.exampleEn: The source of each fact is given in a footnote.
items.exampleZh: 每項事實的出處都寫在腳註裡。

items.exampleEn: Einstein's theory of relativity changed physics forever.
items.exampleZh: 愛因斯坦的相對論永遠改變了物理學。

items.exampleEn: The referee warned the player verbally before giving him a yellow card.
items.exampleZh: 裁判先口頭警告那名球員，之後才給他黃牌。

items.exampleEn: My son likes to personify his toys and talks to them like friends.
items.exampleZh: 我兒子喜歡把玩具擬人化，像跟朋友一樣和它們說話。

items.exampleEn: This program helps with the categorization of your photos by date.
items.exampleZh: 這個程式可以幫你把照片依日期分類。

items.exampleEn: Hyperbole can make a speech funnier, but too much of it sounds false.
items.exampleZh: 誇飾能讓演講更有趣，但用太多聽起來就很假。

items.exampleEn: "The wind sang through the trees" is an example of personification.
items.exampleZh: 「風在樹間歌唱」是擬人法的例子。

items.sentenceEn: The weekly digest lists the most important news from our company.
items.sentenceZh: 每週摘要列出公司最重要的消息。

items.audioEn: Please don't forget to add a footnote for every number you quote.
items.audioZh: 請別忘了為你引用的每個數字加上腳註。
items.questionZh: 說話者提醒聽者做什麼？
options: Add a footnote for each number you quote
Check the spelling of every word
Print two copies for the class

items.sentenceEn: Children's books often personify animals, giving them human feelings.
items.sentenceZh: 童書常把動物擬人化，賦予牠們人類的情感。

items.sentenceEn: Very few people truly understand the theory of relativity.
items.sentenceZh: 真正懂相對論的人非常少。

items.stemEn: Saying you are dying of hunger when you only missed lunch is just ____.
items.stemZh: 只是沒吃午餐就說自己快餓死了，那只是誇飾。

items.stemEn: We agreed on the price ____, but we still need to sign a written contract.
items.stemZh: 我們口頭上談好了價格，但還是需要簽一份書面合約。

items.passageEn: In our writing class this week, the teacher used a short poem to illustrate several techniques. In the first line, the city is personified as a tired giant. "This kind of personification helps readers feel the city's mood," she explained. The second line says the traffic is a thousand miles long, which is clearly hyperbole. She also asked us to read a detailed footnote about the history of the poem. Finally, she warned us that her categorization of these techniques was only a guide, because good writers often mix them. She said she would give us comments verbally next week instead of in writing.
items.passageZh: 這週的寫作課上，老師用一首短詩示範幾種寫作技巧。詩的第一行把城市擬人化成一個疲倦的巨人。她解釋說：「這種擬人法能幫助讀者感受城市的氣氛。」第二行說車陣長達一千英里，這顯然是誇飾。她也要我們讀一段詳細的腳註，內容是這首詩的歷史。最後她提醒我們，她對這些技巧的分類只是參考，因為好的作家常常會混合使用。她說下週會口頭給我們意見，而不是寫在紙上。

questions.questionZh: 詩的第一行把城市比作什麼？
老師說下週會怎麼給意見？

items.promptZh: 這篇文章用了很多擬人法。
referenceEn: This article uses a lot of personification.
There is a lot of personification in this article.
rubricZh: personification 常不可數（例如 a lot of personification）；寫 examples of… 也可

items.instructionZh: 用 hyperbole 造一個句子，舉一個日常生活中誇飾的說法。
referenceEn: My brother uses hyperbole when he says he has a million things to do.
Saying that a bag weighs a ton is a kind of hyperbole.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 hyperbole，表示「誇飾」（例如 That is hyperbole、use hyperbole）
要舉出合理的誇飾例子
